findings.issue_text: src/sentry/monitors/logic/incident_occurrence.py:169 — get_monitor_environment_context() normalizes schedule_type in a copied config but returns the original monitor.config, leaving occurrence contexts with the raw value instead of the display value

src/sentry/monitors/logic/incidents.py:92 — MonitorCheckIn rows are redundantly re-fetched by ID when the threshold is 1 even though failed_checkin is already loaded, adding an avoidable database query to every failure occurrence

goldens.comment: The function modifies the config variable to include display values but then returns the original monitor.config instead of the modified version.
The code fetches MonitorCheckIn objects by ID when the required data already exists in previous_checkins. This creates an unnecessary database query.
